name: Duplicate Channel Reservation
natural_language: Two active reservations must not share the same channel confirmation number.

population.description: Reservations created or arriving in the window that carry a channel confirmation number, excluding cancelled ones.

minihotel.call_cost: O(1) - a single bulk call, then grouped in memory

exceptions.note: Direct bookings carry no channel confirmation number. 7 of 11 sandbox bookings are in this class - without this exception they would all group together and every direct booking would be reported as a duplicate of every other.

predicates.note: At most one ACTIVE reservation per channel confirmation number. Cancelled records are removed by scope before grouping, and records whose confirmation id is not_applicable are never grouped at all - without both, every direct booking would be reported as a duplicate of every other (R7).

execution.rationale: Type A. A duplicate can only appear when a reservation is created.

freshness_requirement.rationale: A duplicate blocks sellable inventory, so it costs money for as long as it persists.

unknown_conditions.when: reservation.status cannot be normalised to active vs cancelled
unknown_conditions.reason: status codes are per-tenant customisable; without a tenant map, superseded reservations cannot be filtered out

caveats: MiniHotel processes an OTA MODIFICATION as cancel + recreate, reusing the same channel confirmation number with a new internal id. Confirmed live: 'test0000000N1' is shared by 007003206 (cancelled) and 007003207 (active). Excluding cancelled reservations is therefore mandatory, not optional - otherwise every guest who ever changed a booking is reported as a duplicate.
Two exclusions are required, not one: cancelled status AND null confirmation number.
